name: Replit
summary: Browser-based coding and app building platform.

flows.title: Start a new chat
steps: Every task in Replit starts with a chat.
Select New in the Replit sidebar.
Use the prompt box to write your request, for example asking Replit to summarise this week's Slack activity and flag the messages that need a reply.
Chats are private: only you reach them in your Workspace.
When the work becomes substantial, ask Replit to turn the chat into a Project, and the context and files gathered so far carry forward.
